risks: The coder-facing then clause names control_depth but does not define the brace-balance algorithm, control-keyword lines, or function-relative base depth; those details exist only outside the fields considered here, so a weak coder could count ordinary block or object nesting incorrectly.
The phrase 'scanned source' does not independently define how test files and vendored/build directories are classified, although the categorical exclusions themselves are clear.

unobservable: Exact classification of a path as a test file or vendored/build directory is not exposed as an activation fact and is explicitly delegated to the detector.
The 3+ code-line threshold and control_depth > 4 are derived source metrics rather than declared activation facts; a Datalog engine would need detector/parser output to observe them.

review.summary: All audited compressions and the sole shared-node routing preserve the source knowledge, and the six additional spot checks also pass, so I agree with the auditor's PASS. The rewrite is substantively complete, but the coder-facing fields alone leave the precise depth algorithm ambiguous and activation depends on detector-supplied scope and metric classifications.
